taxonomic_note: Stable species-level canonical entry; accepted local infraspecific concept S. ericoides var. ericoides is taught internally.
look_here_first: Start with the tiny stiff leaves. White heath aster is a low rhizomatous perennial with many small narrow pointed leaves, short-strigose stems, and masses of small white-rayed heads.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays Natural Purola flora records S. ericoides; Travis herbarium and Williamson county treatment document accepted var. ericoides. Current Kew accepts S. ericoides var. ericoides.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Exact county evidence; accepted local infraspecific concepts reconciled internally.

best_field_traits: many small narrow stiff pointed leaves
